title: Integrative Approaches to Atopic Dermatitis: Exploring Biomarkers, Current Therapies, and the Potential Role of Osteopathic Manipulative Medicine.
snippet: Atopic dermatitis (AD) is a chronic, relapsing, and remitting condition that affects approximately 10% of the population. It is a multifactorial disease involving immune dysregulation, gene mutations, and environmental factors that ultimately disrupt skin barrier restoration, causing pruritic lesions.
